title: Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Software Engineer I — C#/.NET & AI-Assisted Development

Location: Miami, FL

Schedule: Fully onsite, five days per week

Salary: $90,000–$110,000


About the Opportunity

Leon Recruitment is partnering with an established organization to hire a Software Engineer I for its enterprise application development team.

This opportunity is suited to an early-career developer with solid programming fundamentals, practical development experience, and a strong interest in AI-assisted software engineering. Working alongside senior engineers, you will help build and support applications, develop working prototypes, and learn the business processes behind the systems you support.

The team values engineers who ask thoughtful questions, take direction well, troubleshoot systematically, and follow through on their assignments. Success requires both technical curiosity and the ability to understand how software supports everyday business operations.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, test, troubleshoot, and maintain applications using C#, .NET, and Azure services under the guidance of senior engineers.
  • Build and maintain SQL Server queries, stored procedures, views, functions, and supporting data models.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools to support prototyping and development while reviewing and validating the resulting code.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders and technical colleagues to clarify requirements and translate them into working software.
  • Contribute to secure, reliable, and scalable enterprise applications.
  • Participate in sprint planning and deliver assigned work within established timelines.
  • Follow software development lifecycle procedures, including documentation, ticket updates, code reviews, and change management.
  • Learn existing applications, business workflows, and engineering standards, applying feedback as you develop.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field.
  • Experience with AI assisted development tools.
  • Understanding of object-oriented programming and familiarity with software architecture and design principles.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Clear communication and the ability to explain your work, ask for clarification, and collaborate with others.
  • Interest in AI-assisted development and a willingness to learn new tools and approaches.
  • Ability to work onsite in Miami five days per week.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Microsoft development stack (C#/.NET) and Azure.
  • Experience with Git, GitHub, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience with SQL Server development, including T-SQL and familiarity with stored procedures, views, and functions.
  • Understanding of REST APIs and web services.
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum development practices.


What Will Help You Stand Out

Be prepared to discuss an application or feature you personally built or materially contributed to: the problem it addressed, your specific responsibilities, a challenge you encountered, and how you verified that it worked.

Examples may come from employment, internships, academic projects, or independent development. A public GitHub portfolio is welcome but is not required.

To Apply

Submit your resume and a brief description of a relevant development project, including the technologies used and your personal contribution.

companyDescription:
Leon Recruitment is an executive search and staffing firm specializing in Technology, FinTech, Accounting and Finance. We help companies identify, rigorously vet, and hire exceptional talent faster, with a recruiting model built around integrity, persistence, and long-term partnership. 

Unlike high-volume recruiting firms, we operate as an embedded hiring partner, managing the process end-to-end and maintaining close relationships with both clients and candidates to ensure stronger retention and long-term success.

That begins with understanding your business. Before we can represent a company effectively in the talent market, we learn your organization, leadership team, culture, business objectives, hiring processes, technology, and the challenges behind the position.

We actively map the market, pursue passive talent, leverage professional networks, research competing organizations, and continue searching until we have identified candidates who genuinely deserve our client's consideration.

Candidates presented by Leon Recruitment go through a rigorous screening process designed to evaluate far more than whether their resume matches a list of requirements. We want to understand what they have accomplished, the depth of their experience, how they approach their work, why they are considering a move, what motivates them, how they communicate, and whether there is genuine alignment between the candidate, the opportunity, and the organization.

Our clients hire us to recruit. They should not have to perform the screening we were hired to do.

We want to understand what your team needs today, anticipate what it may need tomorrow, and build the institutional knowledge that makes us increasingly valuable with every search we complete together.

title: Generative AI Engineer (Hybrid)
descriptionHtml:
Department

Publix Technology

Job Category

Information Technology/Systems

Description

Publix Super Markets, Inc., the largest employee-owned company in the U.S., is driven by a dynamic technology team of 2,300+ professionals delivering innovative solutions to 1,400+ stores and 260,000+ associates across 8 states. From IT security and platform engineering to architecture, software development, and infrastructure, we offer career opportunities at every level - internships through technical leadership. Join a company consistently ranked among Fortune’s “100 Best Companies to Work For” and help us build more than great subs - build the future of technology at Publix.

Join our Data and AI team as a Generative AI Engineer! In this role, you'll collaborate with cross-functional teams to design, build, and maintain scalable AI solutions and frameworks. Your expertise will drive innovative solutions for complex challenges, leveraging cutting-edge generative AI technologies to create transformative business impacts.

Location: Hybrid (Lakeland, FL):

To support our hybrid work model, candidates must reside, or be willing to relocate, within a commutable distance of Lakeland, FL.

Work Model

Enjoy the best of both worlds - collaborate in person and innovate remotely.

Interview Process

Candidates selected to advance in the interview process will be required to participate in at least one onsite interview at our Lakeland, FL campus.

Why Join Us?

  • Hybrid Flexibility: Work remotely when you need focus time and join us onsite for high-impact collaboration and brainstorming sessions.
  • Operational Efficiency: Ensure technology solutions support efficient workflows and enable automation to improve operational effectiveness.
  • Cutting-Edge AI Projects: Drive innovation in AI platforms, integrating advanced tools and frameworks to solve complex business challenges.
  • Empowered Culture: We value autonomy, creativity, and continuous learning—your ideas shape the future of technology in our organization.

Your Impact

  • Own the development and enhancement of AI platforms by integrating knowledge bases, tools, and innovative features to address evolving business needs.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define requirements, align on priorities, and deliver impactful and user-friendly AI solutions.
  • Research and implement advancements in AI technologies to drive innovation, enhance functionality, and maintain a competitive edge.
  • Prototype and test advanced AI solutions, including multi-agent systems, to solve complex business challenges effectively.
  • Be responsible for defining and tracking KPIs and creating reports to demonstrate the value and impact of AI initiatives.
  • Lead efforts to integrate external systems and tools into AI platforms while ensuring seamless compatibility and optimal user experience.
  • Establish processes to gather user feedback and continuously improve AI tools and solutions based on input.
  • Ensure all AI solutions adhere to data privacy, security, and ethical standards while maintaining high performance and reliability.
  • Drive innovation by exploring emerging technologies and identifying opportunities to future-proof AI systems and processes.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or other analytical discipline or equivalent experience.
  • 1+ years of software engineering experience.
  • 1+ years of experience with designing, developing, and supporting enterprise-level applications.
  • 2+ years of experience with .NET and C# development.
  • 1+ years of experience with TFS/Git code management, DevOps Integration, DevOps Pipelines, or other CI/CD tools.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience with .NET and C# development
  • 3+ years of experience with Front End Development using frameworks like React.js or Angular.js.
  • 1+ years of experience with Azure services like Azure Function Apps, Azure App Services, Azure Static Web App.
  • Experience using Azure AI Services such as Azure AI Foundry, Azure Open AI, Azure Document Intelligence.
  • Experience implementing Gen AI applications using RAG or Function Calling to connect LLMs to custom data sources.
  • Experience using AI Orchestration frameworks such as Semantic Kernel or LangChain or Microsoft Agent Framework.
  • Experience working in an Agile environment.
  • Experience building highly scalable systems and performance tuning them.

Benefits Information

  • Employee stock ownership plan that contributes Publix stock to associates each year at no cost
  • An opportunity to purchase additional shares of our privately-held stock
  • 401(k) retirement savings plan
  • Group health, dental and vision plans
  • Paid Time Off
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Short- and long-term disability insurance
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • Free hot lunches (buffet-style) at facilities with a cafeteria
  • Visit our website to see all of our benefits: https://jobs.publix.com/benefits/

Year End Bonus

As a year-end bonus to associates, Publix issues one month’s extra pay (pro-rated in the first year) each year if associate remains employed through issue date of the bonus check that year. This is calculated as a 13th month of pay in the Potential Annual Pay with Bonus line above.

Additional Information

Your application may have additional steps that you will need to complete in order to remain eligible for consideration. Please be sure to monitor your email, including your spam folder, on a daily basis for critical, time-sensitive emails that could require action within 24-48 hours. Please do not use your Publix email address when applying. Once your application has been successfully submitted you will receive a confirmation email.

  • Please note that Publix will not sponsor any hire for this position for a visa or permanent residence** ***Relocation/Household Good Shipment Allowance will NOT be provided.***

title: Engineering Apex
descriptionHtml:
Learn more about Carvana Apex for early career opportunities here:

Accelerate Your Career!

Explore the Product Apex application here.

Before you proceed to the application, please prepare your 3–5 minute "Apex Pitch" video. See examples from current Carvana employees here.

Your video should be a short walkthrough of what led you to apply and how you went about solving a specific problem using technology. We don’t expect high production value, we just want the real you.

Please Address These Three Areas

  • The "Why": Why Carvana, and why join us at this specific moment?
  • The Track: Why is Software Engineering the right fit for your skills?
  • The Build: Walk us through an AI-driven application or solution you’ve personally built. It can be any project—personal, for school, an internship, etc.
    • Show us what you built and explain the thought-process behind specific decisions you made along the way.
    • Detail exactly how AI played a role in building it—planning, writing code, etc.
    • Use a screen-recording tool and walk us through your prompt creation, documentation, code, or other specific artifacts while you discuss.
    • We are interested in your creative process and problem-solving steps rather than a product demonstration.
How To Record & Share

You can use any tool you like, but our favorites for tech demos allow us to see your face and your screen while you share:

  • Loom (Recommended): Great for "picture-in-picture" recordings of you and your screen.
  • Camtasia or Clipchamp: Best if you want to edit multiple takes together.
  • Zoom: Use “shared screen with speaker view.”

Ensure your video is uploaded to a cloud service such as YouTube or Google Drive and set to "Public,” Unlisted,” or "Anyone with the link can view." Test your link in an Incognito or Private browser window before submitting to make sure we can see it.

About Us And The Apex Program

Carvana is the fastest-growing used auto retailer in U.S. history. Our technology teams are the engine behind:

  • Next-Gen E-commerce: End-to-end platforms for buying and selling cars via Carvana.com and our mobile apps.
  • AI-Driven Support: Proprietary CRM and AI tools managing chat, email, SMS, and voice.
  • Computer Vision: 360° photography and interactive merchandising using cutting-edge AI.
  • Advanced Fintech: The world’s most sophisticated, self-service automotive lending platform.
  • Logistics & Robotics: Managing a nationwide fleet and enterprise-grade automation for the largest reconditioning facilities in the US.
  • AI Developer Experience: Early adoption of AI tools to optimize our own developer efficiency.

What you’ll experience and deliver as part of our inaugural cohort

  • Contribute to Scale: Own medium-to-large projects with cross-functional impact.
  • Write Elite Code: Develop scalable, testable, and modularized solutions.
  • Master the Stack: Work with cloud systems (Azure), Kafka for real-time streaming, and Kubernetes for scaling.
  • Collaborate: Use Agile methodologies to design new features alongside Product and Design. You will be part of a cohort that learns together, and also part of a core team of experienced developers.
  • Stay Ahead: Explore new technologies and approaches to bring Carvana’s engineering to the next level.

What you’ll need to succeed

  • Experience: 0–3 years of software development experience.
  • Tech Stack: Proficiency in C# / .NET Core (GraphQL/RESTful via Web API) and Azure services OR JavaScript / TypeScript (React Hooks, Next.js, Nx).
  • Fundamentals: Strong skills in unit testing, debugging, and API integrations.
  • Mindset: A positive attitude, a willingness to be flexible, and a deep hunger to learn.

Legal stuff

Hiring is contingent on passing a complete background check. This role is eligible for visa sponsorship.

Carvana is an equal employment opportunity employer. All applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, age, mental or physical disability, protected veteran status, or genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law. Carvana also prohibits harassment of applicants or employees based on any of these protected categories.

Please note this job description is not designed to contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

title: Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
As a family company, we serve people and communities. When you work at Meijer, you’re provided with career and community opportunities centered around leadership, personal growth and development. Consider joining our family – take care of your career and your community!

Meijer Rewards

  • Weekly pay
  • Scheduling flexibility
  • Paid parental leave
  • Paid education assistance
  • Team member discount
  • Development programs for advancement and career growth

Please review the job profile below and apply today!

The Software Engineer I, AI designs, develops, tests and supports AI-enabled software applications and services as a member of an Agile development team. This position is part of the AI team within Meijer Technology, which builds and operates the company's enterprise AI assistant and the shared services that support AI-enabled applications across the business. This role delivers assigned features and components, participates in code reviews and testing, and develops a working knowledge of Meijer's technology platforms, including cloud and AI-enabled application development.

Position will follow our hybrid schedule – Monday-Wednesday in office, Thursday-Friday remote.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Delivers assigned features and components, taking on broader ownership over time.
  • Participates in code reviews and applies feedback.
  • Delivers working, tested code and documentation on a regular cadence.
  • Designs, develops, tests and deploys application features and services, including integrations with enterprise systems and data sources.
  • Builds AI-enabled application capabilities, including retrieval components, tool and API integrations, and automated evaluation of AI-generated responses.
  • Builds and deploys containerized services through CI/CD pipelines and operates them in production, including monitoring, alerting and performance tuning.
  • Writes and maintains automated tests; monitors quality and takes corrective action.
  • Participates in the on-call rotation, responds to incidents and contributes to root cause analysis and corrective actions.
  • Uses AI-assisted development tools in daily work and shares effective practices with the team.
  • Writes clear technical documentation, including designs, runbooks and operational procedures.
  • Collaborates with product owners, analysts, security and partner teams on requirements, acceptance criteria and solutions.
  • Participates in Agile team ceremonies and in planning and prioritization.

What You Bring With You (Qualifications)

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Proficiency in at least one modern programming language, such as Python, TypeScript or C#.
  • Understanding of web services, REST APIs, authentication and source control (Git).
  • Familiarity with software testing practices and troubleshooting using logs and monitoring tools.
  • Demonstrated ability to complete software projects through academic, internship, open-source or professional work.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work effectively on a team.
  • Demonstrated use of AI tools in daily work, such as AI-assisted coding, testing, documentation or analysis, with the ability to describe what has worked and what has not.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Exposure to large language model APIs, retrieval-augmented generation or related AI application patterns.
  • Coursework or project experience in machine learning, statistics or data science.
  • Familiarity with containers (Docker) and a major cloud platform (for example Azure, AWS or Google Cloud).
  • Familiarity with CI/CD tooling and infrastructure as code.
  • Familiarity with enterprise platforms such as Databricks or ServiceNow.
  • Experience with Agile methodologies.

descriptionHtml:
About Signant Health

At Signant Health, we help bring life-changing treatments to patients faster. We are a global evidence generation company that supports clinical trials with smart technology, scientific expertise, and hands-on operational support — so better data leads to better decisions in healthcare. We embrace AI and advanced technologies to enhance every aspect of what we do, from data analysis to operational efficiency.


Our teams work at the intersection of science, technology, and patient experience, delivering digital solutions powered by AI innovation that make clinical trials more efficient, more accurate, and more accessible around the world. Trusted by leading pharmaceutical companies and CROs, our platforms and services support studies across more than 90 countries and have contributed to hundreds of new drug approvals.


If you are motivated by meaningful work, global impact, and innovation in clinical research and digital health — including the opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI technologies — you will find purpose and opportunity at Signant Health.


About The Role

Signant Health is looking for a Software Engineer – AI Accelerated Development to build AI-powered, agentic features into our clinical trial platforms. Working across the .NET stack, you will take AI capabilities from backend LLM integration through to a usable front-end — designing agents and agentic workflows, not just prompting a model. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who works with agentic tooling every day and wants to ship production AI in a regulated, high-impact environment. We weigh the depth of your AI and agentic build experience more heavily than years of general experience: a developer with one to three years of substantive, hands-on agentic work is exactly the profile we are targeting.


KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES – Function

  • Design and build AI agents and agentic workflows — tool-use/function calling, multi-step task orchestration, and agent loops — that power Signant Health's clinical trial platforms.
  • Integrate LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, Bedrock, or Azure OpenAI) into .NET application code, handling authentication, streaming, error handling, and cost/latency tradeoffs.
  • Deliver AI features end-to-end, taking them from backend integration through to a usable, production-ready front-end.
  • Build custom agents and tools with the Claude Agent SDK, wiring and steering agent loops.
  • Author custom skills and slash commands for Claude Code to codify team-specific workflows.
  • Implement RAG pipelines and integrate vector stores (e.g. Qdrant, pgvector, Pinecone) to ground agent outputs in trusted data.
  • Instrument agents for evaluation and observability so their outputs can be verified, measured, and audited.
  • Apply AI-specific risk controls appropriate to a regulated clinical environment, addressing hallucination, determinism, and auditability of agent decisions.
  • Use Claude Code (or an equivalent agentic CLI) daily as a primary development tool, reviewing and steering AI-generated diffs.


Knowledge, Skills & Attributes


Essential:

  • Full-stack .NET development — C#/ASP.NET Core on the backend paired with a modern front-end framework.
  • Hands-on agentic development experience — building AI agents or agentic workflows (tool-use/function calling, multi-step task orchestration, agent loops); not just prompting an LLM, but building systems around one.
  • Practical LLM API integration (Anthropic, OpenAI, Bedrock, or Azure OpenAI), including authentication, streaming, error handling, and cost/latency tradeoffs.
  • Proven full-stack delivery of AI features — able to take an agentic/AI feature from backend integration through to a usable front-end, not just a notebook prototype.
  • Daily, hands-on use of Claude Code (or an equivalent agentic CLI) as a primary development tool — comfortable working through multi-step agentic sessions and reviewing and steering AI-generated diffs, rather than occasional autocomplete-style use.
  • Prompt engineering — designing and iterating on system prompts as production software contracts, not one-off experiments.
  • Python proficiency as the preferred language for AI/agent tooling; comfort with async patterns a plus.
  • Evaluation and observability literacy — able to reason about whether an agent's output is correct and instrument it to prove so.


Desirable:

  • Claude Agent SDK experience — building custom agents, defining tools, and wiring agent loops.
  • Working knowledge of agent primitives: hooks (deterministic pre/post-tool-call controls), skills (progressive-disclosure, load-on-demand instructions), subagents/multi-agent delegation, and session/state management.
  • Experience authoring custom skills or slash commands for Claude Code to codify team-specific workflows.
  • Exposure to MCP (Model Context Protocol) for connecting agents to internal tools and data sources.
  • Working knowledge of RAG patterns and vector store integration (e.g. Qdrant, pgvector, Pinecone).
  • Awareness of AI-specific risk areas relevant to a regulated environment (OWASP LLM Top 10, hallucination/determinism concerns, and auditability of agent decisions).


Why Signant Health?

At Signant Health, your work has real impact. Everything we build, support, and deliver helps advance clinical research and bring new treatments to patients faster — improving lives around the world. Our teams combine science, technology, and operational expertise to solve complex clinical trial challenges, and every role contributes to that mission.


We offer a collaborative, global environment where you can grow your career while working alongside experts across clinical, technology, data, and operations, with opportunities to learn, take ownership, and drive meaningful innovation — not just maintain the status quo.


If you are looking for purpose-driven work, smart colleagues, and the opportunity to help shape the future of clinical research and digital health, Signant Health is the place to do it.


At Signant Health, accepting difference isn't enough — we celebrate it, we support it, and we nurture it for the benefit of our team members, our clients, and our community. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer, committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status. Prior to their start date, all candidates are required to be verified through a thorough background check and identity verification to confirm eligibility for employment.


Unsolicited resumes submitted by agencies or third-party recruiters directly to hiring managers or any Signant Health employee will not be considered and will not obligate Signant Health to any fees or terms associated with the submission.

  • Data and AI Technologies: Exposure to machine learning data pipelines, vector search, document processing, data preparation, or generative AI workloads is an advantage.
  • Data Governance: Working knowledge of data governance, data lineage, data quality, and observability practices supporting reliable AI-enabled solutions is preferred.
  • Security and Responsible AI: Understanding of secure software development, privacy protection, intellectual property safeguards, and responsible AI principles, particularly in environments handling sensitive healthcare information.

descriptionHtml:

Do you want to contribute to the development of reliable business applications and AI powered solutions while progressively building the skills needed to take ownership of features, integrations, and AI agent implementations?


KUKA's Business Apps team develops and maintains software solutions supporting Backoffice operations across the AMER region. We are looking for a motivated Junior Software Developer to join our team and contribute to the development of modern business applications, AI powered solutions, and intelligent automation.


This position is ideal for a recent graduate or someone passionate about software development who is eager to learn, experiment with new technologies, and grow alongside an experienced team. Professional experience is not required. We value curiosity, problem solving skills, initiative, and a strong willingness to learn.

NOTE: Although this is a remote role, we will only consider those who are within commutable distance of our corporate office in Sterling Heights, MI as there will be some occasional onsite requirements.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain web applications, APIs, and integrations supporting business processes.
  • Contribute to AI agent development using the Microsoft Agent Framework (MFA).
  • Help integrate AI capabilities into existing applications and enterprise systems.
  • Work with cloud technologies, primarily Microsoft Azure, to build and deploy software solutions.
  • Collaborate with experienced developers on software design, testing, code reviews, and continuous improvement.
  • Explore new technologies and identify opportunities to use AI and automation to improve business processes.


Required Qualifications

  • Knowledge of programming fundamentals and object-oriented programming.
  • Experience with at least one programming language through academic projects, personal projects, internships, or professional work.
  • Interest in web development, APIs, and modern software architectures.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a willingness to learn new technologies.
  • Genuine interest in artificial intelligence, particularly AI agents and software development automation.
  • Good communication skills and ability to work collaboratively in a team.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with JavaScript, TypeScript, React.js, C#, or ASP.NET Core.
  • Basic understanding of REST APIs, SQL databases, and version control tools such as Git.
  • Exposure to Microsoft Azure or another cloud platform.
  • Personal, academic, or professional projects involving AI, automation, or web applications.
  • Familiarity with AI development tools or agent frameworks is a plus but not required.


KUKA is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to building an inclusive and diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, age, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other factor protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.

descriptionHtml:
Overview

AARP is the nation's largest nonprofit, nonpartisan organization dedicated to empowering people 50 and older to choose how they live as they age. With a nationwide presence, AARP strengthens communities and advocates for what matters most to the more than 100 million Americans 50-plus and their families: health and financial security, and personal fulfillment. AARP also works for individuals in the marketplace by sparking new solutions and allowing carefully chosen, high-quality products and services to carry the AARP name. As a trusted source for news and information, AARP produces the nation's largest-circulation publications, AARP The Magazine and the AARP Bulletin.

Information Technology Services is responsible for AARP enterprise-wide technology and information security functions. Services range from infrastructure design and operations, system and software lifecycle implementations, enabling the mobile workforce and protecting AARP network, systems and data. A variety of technologies and practices are used including cloud computing, automation, artificial intelligence and machine learning within highly collaborative Agile teams.

The Engineer I, AI Agents is a technical resource on a platform/capability team responsible for supporting the day-to-day design, implementation and operational activities of the team.

Responsibilities

  • Assisting the team with processing transactions, resolving issues, and administering platform or capability systems, solutions, and services.
  • Maintaining code repositories and Git-based services, if applicable.
  • Writing code, leveraging third-party services, configuring systems, and implementing solutions in an agile way.
  • Collaborating with team to identify technical solutions for business and enterprise needs.
  • Developing technical knowledge and expertise related to domain area systems, solutions, services and applications.

Qualifications

title: Associate AI/ML Engineer
descriptionHtml:
CleanSlate Technology Group (CSTG) is a modern technology consulting firm transforming how organizations use Data, AI, and Cloud Modernization to fuel innovation. As a top-tier cloud partner, we design and deliver AI solutions and modern data platforms that unlock the power of data, accelerate transformation, and enable businesses to build what's next. We help clients accelerate their AI journey with security and governance built on a strong data foundation. With an operational mindset, we break through legacy limitations, simplify complexity, and create future-ready technology foundations that inspire new possibilities. At CSTG, you'll be part of a team that empowers organizations to innovate faster, make smarter decisions, and compete boldly in a rapidly evolving digital world.

Through our Data and AI Practice, we partner with clients to build scalable, reliable data foundations across AWS and Azure. Our focus is on modern data engineering, developing data platforms and pipelines that enable analytics, machine learning, and AI in real world production environments. We believe strong data engineering is critical to making AI useful, trustworthy, and sustainable.

CSTG consultants combine proven engineering practices with a hands-on consulting mindset, helping clients move from strategy to implementation while delivering solutions aligned to real business needs.


What does your team look like:

Our teams bring together CSTG consultants and client stakeholders to solve complex data and AI challenges. As an Associate AI/ML Engineer, you will collaborate with AI/ML, data, and application engineers, developing your primary skills in AI and machine learning while learning how data platforms and applications support reliable, production-ready solutions. We value curiosity, practical problem-solving, and a willingness to learn from others.


What does your role look like:

As an Associate AI/ML Engineer in CSTG’s Data and AI Practice, you will support client delivery by completing well-defined development, testing, and documentation tasks with guidance from experienced engineers. Your work will contribute to AI and machine learning solutions, including generative AI and agent-based use cases, that become part of client production systems.

Associate AI/ML Engineers apply established techniques and learn AI and ML engineering best practices through assigned project work, code reviews, and feedback from experienced team members. You will communicate progress, ask questions, and raise blockers within the delivery team. As you build familiarity with the work, you will participate in client discussions with support from more experienced consultants.

Success in this role means completing assigned work with increasing independence, incorporating feedback, documenting results, and building sound engineering habits. Your focus will be on reliable contributions to team delivery while developing experience with real-world AI solutions.


Responsibilities:

  • Development and integration: Complete assigned development tasks for client AI and machine learning solutions, including generative AI and agent-based capabilities, using established approaches and guidance from experienced engineers.
  • Build and test defined components of AI workflows, services, and integrations alongside data and application platforms, following team designs and review processes.
  • Apply established AI techniques, patterns, and tools to solve well‑defined problems.
  • Testing and evaluation: Run established tests and evaluation procedures, document results and model limitations, and raise unexpected outputs or data quality concerns for review.
  • Participate in design discussions, reviews, and team feedback sessions.
  • Production delivery support: Collaborate with data and application engineers on assigned tasks that help prepare AI solutions for production, following established testing, deployment, and review procedures.
  • Responsible AI: Follow project guidance for data usage, bias, transparency, and privacy. Document concerns and seek guidance before using data or sharing outputs when requirements are unclear.
  • Code quality and documentation: Write clear, maintainable code for assigned tasks, participate in code reviews, incorporate feedback, and document implementation details and test results.
  • Continue developing skills in AI, machine learning, and production delivery practices.


Requirements:

  • Foundational hands-on experience building or supporting AI or machine learning solutions through professional work, internships, coursework, research, or personal projects.
  • Foundational Python skills, including the ability to write, read, and debug simple code for data preparation or AI and machine learning tasks; experience may come from work, coursework, or projects.
  • Familiarity with machine learning, generative AI, or agent‑based approaches.
  • Foundational experience preparing or working with structured or unstructured data for AI use cases, including checking data quality; coursework and project experience are welcome.
  • Foundational understanding of version control and tooling such as Git
  • Exposure to deploying solutions across multistage environments (development, test, and production)
  • Familiarity with AWS, Databricks, or Azure services.
  • Understanding of foundational data engineering concepts, such as data pipelines and data quality.
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly within a team and with client stakeholders.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Exposure to LLM platforms or tools such as Amazon Bedrock, Azure AI Foundry, or similar.
  • Agentic tooling like AWS Quick/Claude/Copilot/OpenClaw/Dots/Grok Bot.
  • Exposure to Agentic development with tooling like Claude Code/Kiro/Cursor.
  • Exposure to MLOps practices, including model versioning or monitoring.
  • Experience working alongside data engineering teams on shared solutions.
  • AWS, Azure, or entry‑level AI/ML certifications.
  • Databricks or Snowflake certifications or willingness to obtain them.
  • Claude certifications or a willingness to obtain them.

descriptionHtml:
About Us


Mintegral is a leading programmatic and interactive mobile advertising platform. Focused on the APAC region and radiating out globally. Powered by advanced AI technology, we provide global advertisers and developers with innovative, comprehensive experiences. With our efficient mobile marketing and monetization solutions, we help our clients exceed their marketing goals.


As Mobvista’s self-developed programmatic platform, since launched in 2015, Mintegral has quickly grown to become one of the largest mobile advertising platforms in Asia. We offer a full stack of programmatic products and services, including our Self-service Platform, DSP, SSP, Ad Exchange and DMP. We have also created the Mindworks Creative Studio, which offers publishers and brands cutting-edge creative solutions, from traditional creative right through to the latest interactive ad formats. For more information, please visit our website: https://www.mintegral.com/en


About the Team

We are building next-generation advertising intelligence platforms that power large-scale, real-time decision systems. Our team develops AI infrastructure and machine learning systems that enable advanced advertising solutions, including large-scale model training, high-performance inference, feature platforms, and embedding services.


We are looking for exceptional Software Engineers who are passionate about AI infrastructure, high-performance computing, and building reliable systems at massive scale. This role is ideal for new graduates and early-career engineers who want to work at the intersection of distributed systems, GPU computing, and machine learning systems.


Responsibilities

  • Design and build high-performance AI infrastructure supporting large-scale advertising machine learning systems.
  • Develop GPU-accelerated machine learning training and inference infrastructure, including distributed training, mixed precision training, and large-scale model optimization.
  • Build and optimize ML systems using modern frameworks and technologies such as PyTorch, TorchRec, and distributed training frameworks.
  • Design and implement high-throughput, low-latency real-time decision systems serving massive volumes of advertising requests.
  • Build efficient data and feature pipelines supporting large-scale embeddings, multimodal features, and real-time feature serving.
  • Develop scalable model serving infrastructure for production machine learning applications.
  • Optimize system performance through parallel computing, GPU acceleration, memory optimization, and advanced system design.
  • Collaborate closely with machine learning engineers and researchers to productionize state-of-the-art models.
  • Build reliable, scalable, and maintainable infrastructure for next-generation advertising AI systems.


Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's, Master's, or Ph.D. degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Operations Research, or related fields.
  • Strong programming skills in C++, Python, Java, Go, or similar languages.
  • Strong foundation in algorithms, data structures, operating systems, distributed systems, and computer architecture.
  • Strong interest in machine learning systems, AI infrastructure, and high-performance computing.
  • Ability to solve complex engineering problems and quickly learn new technologies


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with GPU programming (CUDA), high-performance computing, or system-level performance optimization.
  • Experience with machine learning systems (ML Systems), large-scale AI infrastructure, or distributed training platforms.
  • Familiarity with PyTorch distributed training, TorchRec, DeepSpeed, FSDP, model parallelism, data parallelism, or 2D parallel training strategies.
  • Experience building large-scale machine learning infrastructure, including training platforms, model serving systems, feature platforms, or embedding serving systems.
  • Experience with real-time inference systems, low-latency services, or large-scale data processing.
  • Research projects, internships, or open-source contributions related to AI infrastructure are highly valued.
  • Strong research ability and problem-solving skills.
  • Passion for online advertising, recommendation systems, and intelligent decision-making


Why Join Us

  • Work on challenging AI and machine learning problems at the intersection of advertising, recommendation, and large-scale decision systems.
  • Build technologies that impact hundreds of millions of advertising requests through real-time intelligent decision-making.
  • Directly contribute to improving advertiser performance and ROI through advanced AI systems.
  • Collaborate with talented engineers and researchers working on cutting-edge ML infrastructure and algorithms.
  • Opportunity to work with large-scale models, GPU computing, distributed training, and production AI systems.

title: Digital and AI Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Job Description

Join our team here in the Nuclear Science and Technology directorate at Idaho National Laboratory to design, develop, and enhance cutting-edge data management and AI ecosystem tools. In this role, you'll work on data frameworks, digital twins, and AI/autonomy capabilities that directly support programmatic and research goals across the nation’s leading Nuclear Energy Laboratory. You'll help advance data-for-AI strategies, digital thread and digital twin integration, and agentic AI workflows. You will be shaping the future of how our organization builds and deploys intelligent systems.

What You'll Do

  • Design, develop, and improve the DeepLynx data management and AI ecosystem, including its data frameworks, digital twin capabilities, and supporting infrastructure.
  • Architect digital systems that structure, integrate, and contextualize data for AI, machine learning, and autonomous systems — ensuring data is discoverable, trustworthy, and ready for downstream models and agents.
  • Build and support agentic AI workflows and other AI/ML-driven capabilities within DeepLynx and related digital twin and autonomy applications.
  • Apply full-stack development skills across web, desktop, embedded, and hosted platforms to deliver solutions that support programmatic and research goals.
  • Implement DevOps best practices (CI/CD, containerization, cloud and on-premise deployment) to support scaling and maintenance of DeepLynx and related applications.
  • Follow modern software development practices — agile methodologies, version control, code review, and iterative delivery.
  • Ensure robust testing (unit, integration, system) and maintain clear, up-to-date technical documentation for architecture, APIs, and workflows.
  • Support integration of modeling and simulation capabilities into complex digital systems (e.g., digital twins) that enable autonomy, contributing to domain-specific development (nuclear, chemistry, critical infrastructure, energy delivery/security) as needed.
  • Analyze, test, and maintain data frameworks and simulation-based systems to ensure reliability, performance, and technical validity.
  • Develop system designs, requirements documentation, and program software using languages such as C#/C/C++, Rust, Python, and TypeScript.
  • Provide technical consultation to internal teams on data architecture, AI integration, and testing practices.
  • Contribute to technical publications, conference papers, and reports.
  • Stay current with emerging data, AI, and autonomy technologies.
  • Collaborate with high performing scientists and engineers across INL.

What You Bring

Skills & Knowledge

  • Ability to evaluate and select technical approaches for complex data and software systems
  • Strong grasp of software engineering principles as applied to data management, architecture, and visualization
  • Knowledge of data architecture and modeling principles, including structuring data for AI/ML consumption
  • Familiarity with AI/ML concepts, including agentic AI workflows and their real-world integration
  • Working knowledge of DevOps and modern development practices (agile, version control, CI/CD, containerization)
  • Strong communication skills — able to translate technical concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Excellence collaboration skills and growth mindset.

Required

  • Level 1: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Data Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field.
  • Level 2: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Data Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field and 2 years of relevant experience, or an advanced degree in the same fields.
  • Hands-on experience with containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Proficiency in C# and Python.

The Ideal Candidate Will Possess

  • AWS, Azure, or related cloud certifications.
  • Experience with Rust, TypeScript, and C/C++.
  • Familiarity with Model Based Systems Engineering (MBSE).

Physical Requirements

While performing the duties of this classification, the employee is frequently required to stand, walk, sit, stoop, kneel, bend, use hands to handle materials, manipulate tools, keyboard and type, reach with hands and arms, and operate job-related equipment. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Sufficient visual acuity and hearing capacity to perform the essential functions and interact with people is required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Job Information

  • You will work a 9x80 schedule with every other Friday off at our Collaborative Computing Center in Idaho Falls, Idaho, or from our satellite office in Salt Lake City, Utah.
  • The pay range for this position is: Level 1 ($66,504 - $136,356) / Level 2 ($79,344 - $162,732). At Idaho National Laboratory compensation decisions are determined using factors such as education, relevant experience, and other credentials.
  • Multi-Level: This is a multi-level posting and you will be placed at the appropriate level dependent on depth and breadth of proven experience and skills.
  • TDP: This is a testing designated position; you will be required to submit to a pre-employment drug screen and periodic drug testing throughout the term of your employment.

title: Software Development Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

The SCI Institute

The SCI Institute is a world-class research institute located within the new Warnock Engineering Building on the University of Utah campus. We are a highly dynamic, driven group of over 170 faculty, staff, and students. The overarching goals of the SCI Institute's scientific computing research are to create new techniques, tools, and systems, by which scientists may solve problems affecting various aspects of human life. We believe that to advance the state-of-the-art and create meaningful computational solutions for such complex systems, one needs to advance research in a number of areas within scientific computing, including: visualization, simulation, and modeling. The SCI Institute presents a highly challenging, collaborative work environment that can be deeply rewarding for the right individual. Further information is available at http://www.sci.utah.edu/.

We are seeking multiple Software Development Engineers with experience and interest in state-of-the-art AI technologies, data science, and research software engineering. These positions offer the opportunity to work in a world-renowned research institute alongside faculty, software engineers, PhD students, and PostDocs on the development of cutting-edge AI-ready/agentic infrastructure and data systems.

The Software Development Engineer I/II designs, develops, tests, deploys, and maintains software applications, platforms, and services that support advanced research, artificial intelligence, cloud computing, and data infrastructure initiatives. This position contributes to the development of scalable, secure, and reliable software solutions that enable AI-driven innovation, data integration, scientific workflows, and emerging technology adoption.

Working as part of a multidisciplinary team, the Software Development Engineer participates in all phases of the software development lifecycle, including requirements gathering, system design, development, testing, deployment, documentation, and ongoing support. The position collaborates with researchers, scientists, technical staff, government partners, and industry collaborators to develop software solutions that support initiatives, including the NSF-funded SAFE-AI (Sandbox for Accelerated Feedback and Experimentation for AI Innovation), and National Data Platform (NDP). This will include development and support of secure AI experimentation environments, cloud-native applications, federated data platforms, high-performance computing integrations, and AI-enabled research ecosystems.

A Software Development Engineer I works under general supervision while building foundational software engineering skills and contributing to project deliverables. A Software Development Engineer II demonstrates increased technical proficiency, contributes to system architecture and design decisions, and independently leads components of software development projects.

Learn more about the great benefits of working for University of Utah: benefits.utah.edu

The department may choose to hire at any of the below job levels and associated pay rates based on their business need and budget.

Responsibilities

Software Design and Development

  • Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain software applications, services, APIs, databases, and cloud-based systems.
  • Participate in the full software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, technical design, implementation, testing, deployment, and maintenance.
  • Develop scalable and reliable solutions that support AI, machine learning, data science, cloud computing, and research computing initiatives.
  • Create technical specifications, design documents, and implementation plans based on project requirements and stakeholder needs.
  • Support the development of web applications, middleware, data pipelines, and integrated software platforms.

Cloud, Data, and Infrastructure Engineering

  • Develop and maintain cloud-native solutions using modern cloud platforms and services.
  • Design and implement integrations between distributed data repositories, computing resources, and software services.
  • Contribute to secure, auditable, and scalable environments for AI experimentation, validation, and deployment.
  • Build and maintain APIs, microservices, and data exchange mechanisms that support interoperability across systems.
  • Assist with managing application performance, reliability, security, and scalability.

Research and Emerging Technology Support

  • Collaborate with researchers and subject matter experts to prototype and implement innovative software solutions.
  • Support projects involving artificial intelligence, machine learning, data platforms, scientific workflows, and advanced computing technologies.
  • Evaluate and recommend new technologies, tools, frameworks, and development approaches.
  • Participate in proof-of-concept development, pilot projects, and technology demonstrations.
  • Contribute to the creation of reusable software components and platform capabilities.

Quality Assurance and Support

  • Analyze, troubleshoot, and resolve software defects and performance issues.
  • Perform unit testing, integration testing, system testing, and debugging activities.
  • Review and refactor code to improve maintainability, efficiency, and reliability.
  • Monitor deployed applications and support ongoing operational needs.
  • Ensure software solutions adhere to security, privacy, compliance, and organizational standards.

Collaboration and Documentation

  • Work closely with technical and non-technical stakeholders to gather requirements and translate business needs into technical solutions.
  • Document software architecture, code, deployment procedures, and operational processes.
  • Participate in code reviews and knowledge-sharing activities.
  • Support project planning, sprint activities, and Agile development practices.
  • Communicate technical concepts and project status effectively to diverse audiences.

Additional Responsibilities For Software Development Engineer II

  • Lead technical design and implementation of application components and services.
  • Mentor junior developers and provide guidance on software engineering best practices.
  • Contribute to architectural decisions, technical standards, and development methodologies.
  • Independently manage development tasks and deliverables for complex projects.

Minimum Qualifications

EQUIVALENCY STATEMENT: 1 year of higher education can be substituted for 1 year of directly related work experience (Example: bachelor's degree = 4 years of directly related work experience).Department may hire employee at one of the following job levels:

Software Development Engineer, I: Requires a bachelor's (or equivalency) + 2 years of directly related work experience or a master's (or equivalency) degree.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • Knowledge of software engineering principles and development methodologies.
  • Programming experience in one or more modern languages such as Python, Java, JavaScript, C#, Go, or similar.
  • Understanding of database concepts, APIs, and modern web technologies.
  • Familiarity with source control systems such as Git.
  • Basic understanding of cloud computing concepts and distributed systems.
  • Ability to troubleshoot and debug software issues.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.

Software Development Engineer, II: Requires a bachelor's (or equivalency) + 4 years or a master's (or equivalency) + 2 years of directly related work experience.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • Proficiency in one or more modern programming languages such as Python, Java, JavaScript, C#, Go, or similar.
  • Experience developing cloud-native applications and services.
  • Experience with databases, APIs, and distributed software architectures.
  • Knowledge of software testing, debugging, performance optimization, and security practices.
  • Experience using version control, CI/CD pipelines, and modern development workflows.
  • Ability to independently analyze requirements and deliver technical solutions.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to collaborate with researchers, technical teams, and external stakeholders.

Preferences

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with artificial intelligence, machine learning, generative AI, or data science applications.

Job Summary

The SCI Institute

The SCI Institute is a world-class research institute located within the new Warnock Engineering Building on the University of Utah campus. We are a highly dynamic, driven group of over 170 faculty, staff, and students. The overarching goals of the SCI Institute's scientific computing research are to create new techniques, tools, and systems, by which scientists may solve problems affecting various aspects of human life. We believe that to advance the state-of-the-art and create meaningful computational solutions for such complex systems, one needs to advance research in a number of areas within scientific computing, including: visualization, simulation, and modeling. The SCI Institute presents a highly challenging, collaborative work environment that can be deeply rewarding for the right individual. Further information is available at http://www.sci.utah.edu/.

We are seeking multiple Software Development Engineers with experience and interest in state-of-the-art AI technologies, data science, and research software engineering. These positions offer the opportunity to work in a world-renowned research institute alongside faculty, software engineers, PhD students, and PostDocs on the development of cutting-edge AI-ready/agentic infrastructure and data systems.

The Software Development Engineer I/II designs, develops, tests, deploys, and maintains software applications, platforms, and services that support advanced research, artificial intelligence, cloud computing, and data infrastructure initiatives. This position contributes to the development of scalable, secure, and reliable software solutions that enable AI-driven innovation, data integration, scientific workflows, and emerging technology adoption.

Working as part of a multidisciplinary team, the Software Development Engineer participates in all phases of the software development lifecycle, including requirements gathering, system design, development, testing, deployment, documentation, and ongoing support. The position collaborates with researchers, scientists, technical staff, government partners, and industry collaborators to develop software solutions that support initiatives, including the NSF-funded SAFE-AI (Sandbox for Accelerated Feedback and Experimentation for AI Innovation), and National Data Platform (NDP). This will include development and support of secure AI experimentation environments, cloud-native applications, federated data platforms, high-performance computing integrations, and AI-enabled research ecosystems.

A Software Development Engineer I works under general supervision while building foundational software engineering skills and contributing to project deliverables. A Software Development Engineer II demonstrates increased technical proficiency, contributes to system architecture and design decisions, and independently leads components of software development projects.
